subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as a bundled Claude/GLM harness surface, or require the capability and bridge package to ship as external plugins instead?
rationale: The correct package owner, dependency provenance, persistent-state boundary, and core-versus-plugin API shape cannot be chosen safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Externalize the harness
options.body: Move the Claude and GLM integrations to separately owned plugins or ClawHub packages and retain only generic, reusable core/plugin-SDK seams.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled redesign
options.body: Adopt or republish the bridge under approved ownership and require a narrower refactor that uses SQLite state and documented plugin contracts.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Hold this branch until a maintainer confirms that a new bundled Claude harness is a current product priority.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harness
recommendation.body: Move the Claude and GLM integrations to separately owned plugins or ClawHub packages and retain only generic, reusable core/plugin-SDK seams.

likelyOwner.reason: Branch history repeatedly identifies Eddie as the participant requesting or steering the feature's product surface, though the available signal is indirect.
